messages:
sasha: Quick ask — can someone sketch a tiny 'sprint intake' checklist for bringing up small/quant variants? Need something we can run in <1 day before promoting to a canary. 4-bit LLM experiment.

morgan: Short checklist idea (1-day friendly):
• minimal metadata: model name, base checkpoint, param count, quant config (bits, per-channel/row)
• smoke-func tests: load, forward on 1–3 inputs, KV cache sanity
• perf: single-request p50 token-latency on representative prompt (3 seeds)
• basic quality: 50-shot prompt set + n-gram overlap / embed-similarity check
• regression thresholds & quick rollback steps
• create a canary route with low traffic and auto-fallback

liam: + practical pass/fail numbers to make this concrete:
• load/sanity: model loads in <45s on target infra, no OOM, KV misses <1%
• perf: p50 per-token latency within 1.2x of baseline or <150ms (whichever is higher)
• quality: avg embedding cosine >= 0.94 vs baseline on our 50-sample set OR top-1 answer match >= 95% on extraction tasks
• hallucination quick check: contradiction rate on 20 prompt pairs <3%
• regression: no single prompt where output quality drops >10 pts (annotated score)

liam: Quick command snippet to run the 50-sample harness (example):
```bash
python eval/harness.py --model ./artifacts/quant4b --input eval/mini_50.json --metrics embed_cosine,exact_match --out results.json
```

morgan: If any metric trips, auto-fail and attach `results.json` to the intake ticket. Keep the canary traffic at 1% until a full eval run completes. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: ran quick smoke on node-3 (automated):
• load OK (34s), memory peak 9.8GB, no OOM
• sample latency p50 132ms, p90 218ms
• embed cosine (mini50) = 0.948 vs baseline
• 1 prompt shows truncated generation (likely tokenizer mismatch) — tagging @sasha

sasha: perfect, thanks. i'll open an intake ticket with the checklist and attach the bot results. putting this on today's sprint board.

morgan: also add a step: sanity-check tokenizer config and vocab hash before any eval runs. saved us twice.

liam: if you want i can add a small GH action to run the `mini_50` harness on PRs to model artifacts. low friction.

sasha: yes please — add that and i'll link the action in the ticket.
